children: Lloyds Banking Group seems to have softened its net interest income guidance, despite appearing unchanged at face value, Barclays's Aman Rakkar writes. The British bank now expects 2026 underlying net interest income to be "modestly above" 14.9 billion pounds. It previously forecast the figure to be greater than 14.9 billion pounds. The analyst consensus is for 15.03 billion pounds of net interest income. This suggests a weaker run-rate into 2027 amid competitive pressure on deposits and lending, Barclays notes. Shares are down 3.5%. (michael.hennessey@wsj.com)
